symptom: `diff-local` counted a changed constant, module security (new module role) or any other unit type without a renderer as modified and printed no hunk; `-f struct` said `(no changes)`
cause: The default case of bsonToMDL renders a fixed two-line header, so every unrendered type compares equal; `Security$ModuleSecurity` and `Projects$ModuleSettings` also matched `strings.Contains(unitType, "Module")` and rendered as `create module ;` on both sides
insight: Fixing silent diffs one renderer at a time (#1080, #1393, #1602, #1630) never closes the class: the next unrendered property is silent again. The general guard is cheap because diff-local holds both decoded documents: when the renderings agree but the documents do not, walk them and list the differing paths. Print type and size, never values — the types with no renderer include constants and settings. Pair list elements by Name when every element has a distinct one, or one inserted role reports every later sibling as changed. A test for the dispatch half must assert on the header text; with the field fallback in place the output is no longer empty, so 'no hunk' stops being the signal.
